name: Squat
steps: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart.
Lower your hips while keeping your feet flat.
Push through your feet to stand tall.

name: Push-up
steps: Place your hands just wider than your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line as you lower your chest.
Push the floor away to return to the start.
common_mistake: Allowing the hips to sag or rise too far.

name: Plank
steps: Place your elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Brace your core and breathe steadily.
common_mistake: Holding your breath or letting your lower back sag.

name: Lunge
steps: Stand tall and step one foot forward.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
common_mistake: Allowing the front knee to collapse inward.
